# Criando Documento a partir de um Modelo

```shell Shell
access_token=''

envelope_id=$(curl --request POST \
  --url https://sandbox.clicksign.com/api/v3/envelopes \
  --header "Authorization: $access_token" \
  --header 'Content-type: application/vnd.api+json' \
  --data '{
  "data": {
    "type": "envelopes",
    "attributes": {
			"name": "Envelope de Teste"
    }
  }
}
' | jq -r '.data.id')

template_id=$(curl --request POST \
     --url https://sandbox.clicksign.com/api/v3/templates \
     --header "Authorization: $access_token" \
     --header 'Content-type: application/vnd.api+json' \
     --header 'accept: application/vnd.api+json' \
     --data '
{
  "data": {
    "type": "templates",
    "attributes": {
      "name": "Modelo de Teste.docx",
      "color": "#fccf00",
      "content_base64": "data:application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document;base64,"
    }
  }
}
' | jq -r '.data.id')

document_url=$(curl --request POST \
     --url https://sandbox.clicksign.com/api/v3/envelopes/$envelope_id/documents \
     --header "Authorization: $access_token" \
     --header 'Content-type: application/vnd.api+json' \
     --header 'accept: application/vnd.api+json' \
     --data '
{
  "data": {
    "type": "documents",
    "attributes": {
      "template": {
        "key": "'"$template_id"'",
        "data": {
          "dia": 1,
          "mes": "janeiro",
          "ano": 1990,
          "razao_social": "Razão Social"
        }
      },
      "filename": "Documento de Template.pdf"
    }
  }
}
' | jq -r '.data.links.files.original')

wget -O arquivo_do_template.docx $document_url

```

```json Response Example
{"success":true}
```
